findings.text: the recorded base figure for the gate is wrong - a faithful rerun over the same two files at base 7efeeb77 gives 6 failed 70 passed, the three extra failures being exactly the new quoted cases, against the recorded "same 3 failed 70 passed"; the row's own counts sum to 73 where 76 cases were collected, so it hides that the new gate cases fail at base.

an empty quoted scalar now parses where it used to refuse: _strip_matching_quotes maps "" and '' to an empty string, so 'status: ""' yields status '' instead of the base ManifestParseError, and _refuse_undetermined_status neither refuses the empty word (line 376 needs a truthy status) nor reaches the missing-status refusal (line 369 sees the key as present) - an unasserted behaviour change on the refusal axis this plan treats as load-bearing.

a quoted scalar does not decode when it is a continuation list item: changed_paths: "a.py" followed by - "b.py" parses to ['a.py', '"b.py"'] on the head reader, so the same quoting habit still costs a wrong value one line below the fix, and no case in tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py covers the continuation branch.

justifications.durability: the new cases are load-bearing falsifiers - the same 76 cases over the same two files give 6 failed 70 passed against the base reader versus 3 failed 73 passed at head, the three extra being exactly the quoted cases - so removing the strip is caught by tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py:592.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py:592 and :619 assert the measure and its result is recorded, and I reproduced the defect independently (both quoted forms raise ManifestParseError at base and parse at head), but the archive's base figure is mis-recorded as the first finding states.
justifications.fit: the helper, its comment block and its name sit beside the existing guards at reckon/crew/reports.py:99-103 in the same style, and no symbol, path or comment carries a plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:295 strips one matching pair where a top-level text scalar is read, so status: "complete" and status: 'complete' parse to the verdict the worker wrote while the unquoted, apostrophe and lone-quote shapes keep base behaviour.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py, docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html and the evidence archive) is inside the node's declared write paths, and the worktree is clean with nothing outside the fence touched.
